Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1942 (Alpha-2B adrenergic receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno as an inner join. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1942, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate.
